phoneticConvention: Approximate English respelling for English-speaking readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; j and g before e/i → kh as in Scottish 'loch'; ñ → ny; ll → y; c before e/i and z → s; r is rolled; monosyllables in capitals). Standard Castilian with seseo and yeísmo. No substitute for the audio.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended.
title: Asking and negotiating
goal: Ask politely, express a condition and negotiate simply.

model.note: Polite conditional, usted form. '¿Podría…?' also means 'could I' (next model).

variants.phon: poh-DREE-ah ah-yoo-DAHR-meh, POHR fah-VOHR
variants.native: Could you help me, please?

variants.phon: poh-DREE-ah ehn-VEEAHR-meh LAH fahk-TOO-rah, POHR fah-VOHR
variants.native: Could you send me the invoice, please?

variants.phon: poh-DREE-ah ah-SEHR-meh OON dehs-KOOEHN-toh, POHR fah-VOHR
variants.native: Could you give me a discount, please?

variants.phon: poh-DREE-ah DAHR-meh MAHS TEEEHM-poh, POHR fah-VOHR
variants.native: Could you give me more time, please?

model.note: Same form 'podría' for yo and usted: the context (or 'yo') removes the ambiguity.

variants.phon: poh-DREE-ah pah-GAHR KOHN tahr-KHEH-tah

variants.phon: SEE POOEH-doh deh-vohl-VEHR-loh, LOH KOHM-proh

model.note: Si + present, simple future (llamaré). With usted: 'le llamaré'.

variants.study: Si hay algún problema, te llamaré.

variants.phon: SEE tehr-MEE-noh PROHN-toh, TEH yah-mah-REH

variants.phon: SEE KAHM-beeah AHL-goh, TEH yah-mah-REH

variants.phon: SEE YEH-goh TAHR-deh, TEH yah-mah-REH

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buenos días. ¿Cuánto cuesta esta lámpara?
turns.phon: BOOEH-nohs DEE-ahs. KOOAHN-toh KOOEHS-tah EHS-tah LAHM-pah-rah
turns.native: Good morning. How much is this lamp?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sesenta euros.
turns.phon: seh-SEHN-tah EHOO-rohs
turns.native: Sixty euros.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Es demasiado caro para mí. ¿Me puede hacer un descuento?
turns.phon: EHS deh-mah-SEEAH-doh KAH-roh PAH-rah MEE. MEH POOEH-deh ah-SEHR OON dehs-KOOEHN-toh
turns.native: That's too expensive for me. Can you give me a discount?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Puedo dejársela en cincuenta.
turns.phon: POOEH-doh deh-KHAHR-seh-lah EHN seen-KOOEHN-tah
turns.native: I can let you have it for fifty.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Si me la deja en cuarenta y cinco, me la llevo.
turns.phon: SEE MEH LAH DEH-khah EHN kooah-REHN-tah EE SEEN-koh, MEH LAH YEH-voh

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Vale, pero solo si paga en efectivo.
turns.phon: VAH-leh, PEH-roh SOH-loh SEE PAH-gah EHN eh-fehk-TEE-voh
turns.native: OK, but only if you pay in cash.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: De acuerdo. ¿Podría envolverla, por favor?
turns.phon: DEH ah-KOOEHR-doh. poh-DREE-ah ehn-vohl-VEHR-lah, POHR fah-VOHR
turns.native: All right. Could you wrap it, please?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Claro, ahora mismo.
turns.phon: KLAH-roh, ah-OH-rah MEES-moh
turns.native: Of course, right away.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Hola, señor García. Quería preguntarle si puede arreglar la calefacción.
turns.phon: OH-lah, seh-NYOHR gahr-SEE-ah. keh-REE-ah preh-goon-TAHR-leh SEE POOEH-deh ah-rreh-GLAHR LAH kah-leh-fahk-SEEOHN

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: ¿Qué pasa?
turns.phon: KEH PAH-sah
turns.native: What's wrong?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: No funciona desde el lunes y hace frío.
turns.phon: NOH foon-SEEOH-nah DEHS-deh EHL LOO-nehs EE AH-seh FREE-oh
turns.native: It hasn't worked since Monday and it's cold.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Lo siento, voy a llamar al técnico hoy mismo.
turns.phon: LOH SEEEHN-toh, VOHEE AH yah-MAHR AHL TEHK-nee-koh OHEE MEES-moh
turns.native: I'm sorry, I'll call the technician today.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Gracias. ¿Sería posible venir antes del viernes?
turns.phon: GRAH-seeahs. seh-REE-ah poh-SEE-bleh veh-NEER AHN-tehs DEHL VEEEHR-nehs
turns.native: Thank you. Would it be possible to come before Friday?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Creo que sí. Si hay algún problema, le llamaré.
turns.phon: KREH-oh KEH SEE. SEE AHEE ahl-GOON proh-BLEH-mah, LEH yah-mah-REH
turns.native: I think so. If there's any problem, I'll call you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Perfecto. Otra cosa: ¿podría pagar el alquiler el día cinco este mes?
turns.phon: pehr-FEHK-toh. OH-trah KOH-sah, poh-DREE-ah pah-GAHR EHL ahl-kee-LEHR EHL DEE-ah SEEN-koh EHS-teh MEHS
turns.native: Perfect. One more thing: could I pay the rent on the fifth this month?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Vale, pero solo si me lo confirma por escrito.
turns.phon: VAH-leh, PEH-roh SOH-loh SEE MEH LOH kohn-FEER-mah POHR ehs-KREE-toh
turns.native: OK, but only if you confirm it to me in writing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sin problema, le envío un correo.
turns.phon: SEEN proh-BLEH-mah, LEH ehn-VEE-oh OON koh-RREH-oh
turns.native: No problem, I'll send you an email.

dialogues.situation: Asking for more time at work

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Marta, ¿tienes un momento?
turns.phon: MAHR-tah, TEEEH-nehs OON moh-MEHN-toh
turns.native: Marta, do you have a moment?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sí, dime.
turns.phon: SEE, DEE-meh
turns.native: Yes, go ahead.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Necesito dos días más para terminar el informe.
turns.phon: neh-seh-SEE-toh DOHS DEE-ahs MAHS PAH-rah tehr-mee-NAHR EHL een-FOHR-meh
turns.native: I need another two days to finish the report.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: ¿Por qué? El plazo es mañana.
turns.phon: POHR KEH. EHL PLAH-soh EHS mah-NYAH-nah
turns.native: Why? The deadline is tomorrow.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Es que el cliente cambió los datos ayer.
turns.phon: EHS KEH EHL KLEEEHN-teh kahm-BEEOH LOHS DAH-tohs ah-YEHR
turns.native: It's just that the client changed the data yesterday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Vale, pero solo si lo entregas el jueves por la mañana.
turns.phon: VAH-leh, PEH-roh SOH-loh SEE LOH ehn-TREH-gahs EHL KHOOEH-vehs POHR LAH mah-NYAH-nah
turns.native: OK, but only if you hand it in on Thursday morning.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sí, te lo prometo. Si termino antes, te lo envío.
turns.phon: SEE, TEH LOH proh-MEH-toh. SEE tehr-MEE-noh AHN-tehs, TEH LOH ehn-VEE-oh
turns.native: Yes, I promise. If I finish earlier, I'll send it to you.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: De acuerdo. Lo siento, pero no puedo darte más tiempo.
turns.phon: DEH ah-KOOEHR-doh. LOH SEEEHN-toh, PEH-roh NOH POOEH-doh DAHR-teh MAHS TEEEHM-poh

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Lo entiendo, gracias.
turns.phon: LOH ehn-TEEEHN-doh, GRAH-seeahs
turns.native: I understand, thanks.

readiness: Ask politely in the conditional (podría, sería posible, le importaría), set a condition (si + present, future), negotiate a price or a deadline, accept on a condition, decline with a reason, apologise and offer to put things right.
